content: Shini Asiman Zemin
Bi pse shini asiman, zemin chanlawo. Eqighanku asiman, zemin widawo, haiye widawo.
Bi pse chanlase zhiguitu chenshi shini Yelusalen asimanyi Hudai hhense bouzhezho. Hoxian shini bierei zhanguijidene oluzhi dabala goudasei xianli.
Bi pse sonosuse fugie shenqi baozose khizhezhi kieliezho,

content.text: Pse fuguku uwo, pse nango gieku, wilaku, tendun uwo.

content: Baozo sousan kieliewo, "Uzhe, bi soyujilai shinishighazho." Pse kieliewo, "Chi huai, enezighan kielienshi kekao, zhenni wo."
Hhe made pse kieliewo, "Chenjiwo! Bishi Alafa wo, Emeiga wo, jiushi keitou wo, baraku wo. Bi aminni bula usuni undasusan kunde belien ughane.
Injisan kunla enezighanyi jienliezhi caichan giene. Bi hhende Huda danlane, hhe made kewon danlane.

Danzi meilatu, xianxin ulie giechen, hanzhan gieghachen, kun alachen, lon kijiechen, fashu shuaichen, nigieda beiichen, da soyuji ghudan kieliechen kunlai guzi siderasan liuhontu khantu hude wo. Eneshi ji 2 hui fuguku wo."
Shini Yelusalen
Zuihouku dolon zeinanni zhonlo durughasan dolon antan ighani bareisan dolon qienxien dundadu nie made kieliewo, "Chi ire, bi chade shini biereii uzheghaye, ghoni ghughanyi bierei wo."
Shenlin mii zhughei gojiolughazhi qienxien mii uduruzhi nie undu fugie ulade echi, asimanni Hudai hhense bouzhesan zhiguitu chenshi Yelusalenni made uzheghawo.
Chenshide Hudai fama wine. Faisan gon guizhuntu boushi, ishini xianli, gieghantu shuijin niekielien wo.
Hhende fugie undu dan wine, 12 gie wijien wo. Wijien jiere 12 gie qienxien wine. Wijien jiere Isilieni 12 gie paini nierei huaizho.
Dunmiende ghuran wijien, beimiende ghuran wijien, nanmiende ghuran wijien, ximiende ghuran wijien wo.
Chenshini dande 12 gie jichu wo, jichu jiere ghoni ghughanyi 12 gie shituni niere wine.
Made kielien kieliesan qienxien antanni ghulusunyi bareizhi chenshi, wijien, danni nanjine giezho.
Chenshishi jieran mien wo, fudu, aghui niekielien wo. Qienxien ghulusunghala chenshini nanjise man 12000 sitaji wo. Fudu, aghui, unduni niekielien wo.
Hhe zhao kunni chicun, yeshijiu qienxienni chicunghala danni nanjise 144 zhou wo.
Danshi ishighala giesan wo, chenshishi gou antanghala giesan wo, gieghande boli niekielien wo.
Danni jichui yanyanji boushighala dabalaghazho. Ji 1 gie jichushi ishi wo, ji 2 gieshi kugie boushi wo, ji 3 gieshi noghon manou wo, ji 4 gieshi noghon boushi wo,

ji 5 gieshi hulan manou wo, ji 6 gieshi hulan boushi wo, ji 7 gieshi shira boushi wo, ji 8 gieshi noghon ishi wo, ji 9 gieshi shira ishi wo, ji 10 gieshi feicui wo, ji 11 gieshi zishei manou wo, ji 12 gieshi zishei shuijin wo.
12 gie wijienshi 12 gie zhenzhughala giesan wo, nie wijienshi nie zhenzhu wo. Chenshini geidoushi gou antanghala giesan wo, gieghande boli niekielien wo.
Bi chenshi sudoro dajien chanla dakushi Fugie Nenlitu Ezhan Hudaji ghoni ghughanshi chenshini dajien wo.
Chenshide naran, sarani gonni ulie kerekushi Hudai fama zhouizho, ghoni ghughanshi chenshini zhula wo.
Gojiala hhe gon dunda yone. Zemin jieredu honshanla famanine deilazhi hhe chenshide echine.
Chenshini wijienyi izhi ulie khane, hhende xieni uwo.
Kunla gojialani fama, zhiguini deilazhi hhende echine.
Jien ganjin witu, pse hanzhan gieghachen, ghudan kieliechenlai hhende ulie oroghane. Zinie ghoni ghughanyi aminni jilasan benzi jiere nierei jilasanlai oroghane.
